mapper.select: SELECT S.STORE_ID, S.STORE_NAME, S.USER_ID, S.BUSINESS_NO, S.STORE_INTRO, S.DELIVERY_YN, S.IS_CHAT_ENABLED, S.CHAT_START, S.CHAT_END, S.STORE_ADDR, S.STORE_AREA, S.STORE_PASS, S.REJECT_REASON, S.GRADE_CODE, S.MEMBERSHIP, S.REG_DATE, S.UDATE, -- 멤버십 테이블과 조인하여 실제 멤버십 상태 확인 CASE WHEN M.MEMBERSHIP_ID IS NOT NULL AND M.MEMBERSHIP_STATUS = 'A' AND M.EXPIRATION_DATE >= SYSDATE THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS MEMBERSHIP_YN FROM SELLER_INFO_TBL S LEFT JOIN MEMBERSHIP_TBL M ON S.USER_ID = M.USER_ID WHERE S.USER_ID = #{userId} AND S.STORE_PASS = 'P' ORDER BY S.STORE_ID

SELECT s.STORE_NAME, TO_CHAR(o.ORDER_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') AS ORDER_MONTH, COUNT(o.ORDER_ID) AS ORDER_COUNT, SUM(o.TOTAL_PRICE) AS TOTAL_SALES FROM SELLER_INFO_TBL s JOIN ORDER_TBL o ON s.STORE_NAME = o.STORE_NAME WHERE s.USER_ID = #{userId} GROUP BY s.STORE_NAME, TO_CHAR(o.ORDER_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY ORDER_MONTH

SELECT TO_CHAR(O.ORDER_DATE, 'YYYY.MM') AS MONTH, SUM(O.TOTAL_PRICE - O.DELIVERY_FEE) AS TOTAL FROM ORDER_TBL O JOIN SELLER_INFO_TBL S ON O.STORE_NAME = S.STORE_NAME WHERE S.USER_ID = #{userId} AND O.STATUS = 'P' GROUP BY TO_CHAR(O.ORDER_DATE, 'YYYY.MM') ORDER BY TO_CHAR(O.ORDER_DATE, 'YYYY.MM')

SELECT T1.USER_NAME, T2.ORDER_ID, T2.TOTAL_PRICE, T2.STATUS,
MAX(T2.ORDER_DATE) AS ORDER_CREATED_AT, -- ⭐ NEW 판단용 (실제 존재 컬럼)
MAX(T3.PRO_NAME) AS PRO_NAME, MAX(T4.OPTION_NAME) AS OPTION_NAME, MAX(T5.VALUE_NAME) AS VALUE_NAME, MAX(T3.PRICE) AS PRICE, MAX(T6.PRICE_DIFF) AS PRICE_DIFF,
COALESCE( MAX(T9.PICKUP_DATE), MAX(T2.ORDER_DATE) ) AS PICKUP_DELIVERY_DATE,
MAX(T10.STORE_NAME) AS STORE_NAME,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_MSG_TBL m WHERE m.ORDER_ID = T2.ORDER_ID AND m.IS_READ = 'N' AND m.USER_ID != #{userId} ) AS UNREAD_COUNT
FROM ORDER_TBL T2 JOIN USER_TBL T1 ON T2.USER_ID = T1.USER_ID JOIN ORDER_DETAIL_TBL T3 ON T2.ORDER_ID = T3.ORDER_ID JOIN PRODUCT_TBL T8 ON T3.PRO_NO = T8.PRO_NO JOIN SELLER_INFO_TBL T10 ON T8.STORE_ID = T10.STORE_ID LEFT JOIN ORDER_OPTION_TBL T6 ON T3.ORDER_DETAIL_ID = T6.ORDER_DETAIL_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_OPTION_TBL T4 ON T6.TOP_OPTION_ID = T4.TOP_OPTION_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_SUB_OPTION_TBL T5 ON T6.SUB_OPTION_ID = T5.SUB_OPTION_ID LEFT JOIN PICKUP_TBL T9 ON T2.ORDER_ID = T9.ORDER_ID
WHERE T10.USER_ID = #{userId}
GROUP BY T1.USER_NAME, T2.ORDER_ID, T2.TOTAL_PRICE, T2.STATUS
ORDER BY PICKUP_DELIVERY_DATE DESC, T2.ORDER_ID DESC

SELECT T1.USER_NAME, T2.ORDER_ID, T2.STATUS, T2.DELIVERY_TYPE, T3.PRO_NAME, T11.FILEPATH || T11.FILENAME AS PRO_IMAGE_URL, -- 이미지 경로 추가 COALESCE(T9.PICKUP_DATE, T2.ORDER_DATE) AS ORDER_OR_PICKUP_DATE, T10.STORE_NAME, T2.TOTAL_PRICE, T3.PRICE AS PRODUCT_PRICE, T2.ADD_OPTION_PRICE AS MANUAL_OPTION_PRICE, T2.LETTERING_WORD, SUM(NVL(T6.PRICE_DIFF, 0)) AS AUTO_OPTION_PRICE_DIFF, LISTAGG(T4.OPTION_NAME || ': ' || T5.VALUE_NAME, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY T6.ORDER_OPTION_ID) AS OPTION_DETAILS, T2.CHAT_YN,
T7.DELI_ID, T7.DELIVERY_STATUS, T7.RECEIVER_NAME, T7.PHONE AS RECEIVER_PHONE, T7.ADDRESS AS DELIVERY_ADDRESS, T7.DELIVERY_FEE, T7.COURIER_COM, T7.TRUCKING_NUMBER, T7.WISH_DELI FROM ORDER_TBL T2 JOIN USER_TBL T1 ON T2.USER_ID = T1.USER_ID JOIN ORDER_DETAIL_TBL T3 ON T2.ORDER_ID = T3.ORDER_ID JOIN PRODUCT_TBL T8 ON T3.PRO_NO = T8.PRO_NO JOIN SELLER_INFO_TBL T10 ON T8.STORE_ID = T10.STORE_ID LEFT JOIN ORDER_OPTION_TBL T6 ON T3.ORDER_DETAIL_ID = T6.ORDER_DETAIL_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_OPTION_TBL T4 ON T6.TOP_OPTION_ID = T4.TOP_OPTION_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_SUB_OPTION_TBL T5 ON T6.SUB_OPTION_ID = T5.SUB_OPTION_ID LEFT JOIN DELIVERY_TBL T7 ON T2.ORDER_ID = T7.ORDER_ID LEFT JOIN PICKUP_TBL T9 ON T2.ORDER_ID = T9.ORDER_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PRO_NO, FILEPATH, FILENAME FROM PRODUCT_IMG_TBL WHERE FILEUSE = 'T' -- 상위 이미지(썸네일) AND ROWNUM = 1 ) T11 ON T8.PRO_NO = T11.PRO_NO WHERE T2.ORDER_ID = #{orderId} GROUP BY T1.USER_NAME, T2.ORDER_ID, T2.STATUS, T2.DELIVERY_TYPE, T3.PRO_NAME, T11.FILEPATH, T11.FILENAME, COALESCE(T9.PICKUP_DATE, T2.ORDER_DATE), T10.STORE_NAME, T2.TOTAL_PRICE, T2.CHAT_YN, T3.PRICE, T2.ADD_OPTION_PRICE, T2.LETTERING_WORD, T3.ORDER_DETAIL_ID,
T7.DELI_ID, T7.DELIVERY_STATUS, T7.RECEIVER_NAME, T7.PHONE, T7.ADDRESS, T7.DELIVERY_FEE, T7.COURIER_COM, T7.TRUCKING_NUMBER, T7.WISH_DELI ORDER BY T3.PRO_NAME
SELECT MSG_ID, CHAT_ID, ORDER_ID, USER_ID, STORE_ID, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(MESSAGE, 4000, 1) AS MESSAGE, MESSAGE_TYPE, SENT_AT, IS_READ FROM CHAT_MSG_TBL WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId} ORDER BY SENT_AT ASC
mapper.insert: SELECT CHAT_MSG_SEQ.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL INSERT INTO CHAT_MSG_TBL ( MSG_ID, CHAT_ID, ORDER_ID, USER_ID, STORE_ID, MESSAGE, MESSAGE_TYPE, SENT_AT, IS_READ ) VALUES ( #{msgId}, (SELECT CHAT_ID FROM CHAT_TBL WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId}), #{orderId}, #{userId}, #{storeId}, <choose> <when test="messageType == 'IMAGE'">#{filePath}</when> <otherwise>#{message}</otherwise> </choose> , #{messageType}, SYSDATE, 'N' )
mapper.update: UPDATE CHAT_TBL SET LAST_MSG_AT = SYSDATE, LAST_MSG = <choose> <when test="messageType == 'IMAGE'">이미지를 보냈습니다.</when> <otherwise>SUBSTR(#{message},1,200)</otherwise> </choose> , UNREAD_COUNT = UNREAD_COUNT + 1 WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId}
mapper.select:
SELECT R.REVIEW_ID, R.ORDER_ID, R.RATING, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(R.REVIEW_CONTENT) AS REVIEW_CONTENT, R.CDATETIME, R.USER_ID, S.STORE_ID, S.STORE_NAME, S.USER_ID AS 판매자_ID FROM REVIEW_TBL R JOIN SELLER_INFO_TBL S ON R.STORE_ID = S.STORE_ID
WHERE S.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY R.CDATETIME DESC
mapper.update:
UPDATE ORDER_TBL SET LETTERING_WORD = #{letteringWord},
-- ⭐ 1. 기존 TOTAL_PRICE에서 이전 ADD_OPTION_PRICE 값을 빼줍니다. -- ⭐ 2. 새로 전송된 ADD_OPTION_PRICE 값을 더해줍니다. -- (NVL을 사용하여 null 값이 들어와도 0으로 처리, 하지만 JS에서 이미 0 이상으로 처리하고 있습니다.) TOTAL_PRICE = (TOTAL_PRICE - NVL(ADD_OPTION_PRICE, 0)) + NVL(#{addOptionPrice}, 0),
-- ⭐ 새로운 ADD_OPTION_PRICE 값으로 필드를 업데이트합니다. ADD_OPTION_PRICE = NVL(#{addOptionPrice}, 0),
-- STATUS를 'C'로 업데이트합니다. (기존 쿼리 유지) STATUS = 'C'
WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId}
mapper.select: SELECT P.ORDER_ID, TO_CHAR(P.PICKUP_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS PICKUP_START_DATE, TO_CHAR(P.PICKUP_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS PICKUP_END_DATE FROM PICKUP_TBL P INNER JOIN ORDER_TBL O ON P.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID INNER JOIN SELLER_INFO_TBL S ON O.STORE_NAME = S.STORE_NAME WHERE S.USER_ID = #{userId} AND NVL(O.STATUS, ' ') != 'X'

SELECT U.USER_ID, U.USER_NAME, U.EMAIL, U.USER_ADDR, U.PHONE, U.ROLE, U.USER_STATUS, U.JOIN_CDATE, U.UDATE, S.STORE_ID, S.STORE_NAME, S.BUSINESS_NO, S.STORE_INTRO, S.DELIVERY_YN, S.IS_CHAT_ENABLED, S.CHAT_START, S.CHAT_END, S.STORE_ADDR, S.MEMBERSHIP FROM USER_TBL U JOIN SELLER_INFO_TBL S ON U.USER_ID = S.USER_ID WHERE U.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY S.STORE_ID ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT * FROM SELLER_INFO_TBL WHERE STORE_ID = #{storeId}
mapper.update:
UPDATE USER_TBL
USER_PASS = #{userPass},
USER_NAME = #{userName},
EMAIL = #{email},
USER_ADDR = #{userAddr},
PHONE = #{phone}, UDATE = SYSDATE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}

UPDATE SELLER_INFO_TBL
STORE_NAME = #{storeName},
STORE_INTRO = #{storeIntro},
STORE_ADDR = #{storeAddr},
DELIVERY_YN = #{deliveryYn}, IS_CHAT_ENABLED = #{isChatEnabled}, CHAT_START = #{chatStart}, CHAT_END = #{chatEnd}, MEMBERSHIP = #{membership}, UDATE = SYSDATE
WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SELLER_IMG_TBL ( SELLER_IMG_NUM, STORE_ID, FILEUSE, FILEPATH, FILENAME, FILEORGNAME, FILEETC ) VALUES ( SEQ_SELLER_IMG_NUM.NEXTVAL, #{storeId}, #{fileUse}, #{filePath}, #{fileName}, #{fileOrgName}, #{fileEtc} )
mapper.select: SELECT p.PRO_NO, -- 상품 번호 p.PRO_NAME, -- 상품명 p.PRO_TYPE, -- 상품 종류 p.PRICE, -- 가격 p.STATUS, -- 현재 상태 q.QUESTION_ID, -- 질문 ID q.QUESTION_CONTENT, -- 질문 내용 q.QUESTION_DATE, -- 질문 작성일 q.ANSWER_CONTENT, -- 답변 내용 q.ANSWER_DATE, -- 답변일 s.STORE_NAME, -- 가게 이름 s.STORE_ADDR -- 가게 주소 FROM QA_TBL q JOIN PRODUCT_TBL p ON q.PRO_NO = p.PRO_NO JOIN SELLER_INFO_TBL s ON p.STORE_ID = s.STORE_ID WHERE s.USER_ID = #{userId} -- 로그인한 사용자 ID AND p.STORE_NAME = s.STORE_NAME -- 해당 상품이 로그인한 유저의 가게에 속하는지 확인 -- 스윗디저트 가게의 소유자가 로그인한 유저인지 확인 ORDER BY q.QUESTION_DATE DESC -- 질문 작성일 기준 내림차순 정렬
mapper.update: UPDATE QA_TBL SET ANSWER_CONTENT = #{answerContent}, ANSWER_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE QUESTION_ID = #{questionId}
mapper.select: SELECT SI.STORE_NAME, SI.STORE_ADDR, SI.STORE_INTRO, SI.DELIVERY_YN, SI.IS_CHAT_ENABLED AS CHAT_YN, SI.MEMBERSHIP AS IS_MEMBERSHIP, M.MEMBERSHIP_LEVEL FROM SELLER_INFO_TBL SI LEFT JOIN MEMBERSHIP_TBL M ON SI.USER_ID = M.USER_ID WHERE SI.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY SI.STORE_ID ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
mapper.update: UPDATE SELLER_INFO_TBL SET STORE_NAME = #{storeName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, STORE_ADDR = #{storeAddr, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, STORE_INTRO = #{storeIntro, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, DELIVERY_YN = #{deliveryYn, jdbcType=CHAR}, IS_CHAT_ENABLED = #{isChatEnabled, jdbcType=CHAR}, UDATE = SYSDATE WHERE STORE_ID = #{storeId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND USER_ID = #{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.insert: SELECT SEQ_PRO_NO.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL INSERT INTO PRODUCT_TBL ( PRO_NO, STORE_ID, PRO_NAME, PRO_TYPE, PRO_INFO, PRICE, DELIVERY_FEE, STATUS, LETTERING, CNT, SELL_COUNT, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, STORE_NAME ) VALUES ( #{proNo}, #{storeId}, #{proName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{proType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{proInfo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{price}, #{deliveryFee, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{status, jdbcType=CHAR}, #{lettering, jdbcType=CHAR}, #{cnt}, #{sellCount}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE, #{storeName, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )

SELECT PRODUCT_OPTION_SEQ.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL INSERT INTO PRODUCT_OPTION_TBL ( TOP_OPTION_ID, PRO_NO, OPTION_NAME, IS_QUANTITY_SELECTABLE ) VALUES ( #{topOptionId}, #{proNo}, #{optionName}, #{isQuantitySelectAble, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )

SELECT SUB_OPTION_SEQ.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO PRODUCT_SUB_OPTION_TBL ( SUB_OPTION_ID, TOP_OPTION_ID, VALUE_NAME, PRICE_DIFF ) VALUES ( #{subOptionId}, #{topOptionId}, #{valueName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{priceDiff, jdbcType=NUMERIC} )
mapper.select: SELECT PRO_NO, PRO_NAME, PRO_TYPE, STORE_ID, STORE_NAME, PRICE, DELIVERY_FEE, STATUS, PRO_INFO, LETTERING, CNT, SELL_COUNT, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM PRODUCT_TBL WHERE PRO_NO = #{proNo}

SELECT PO.TOP_OPTION_ID, PO.PRO_NO, PO.OPTION_NAME, PSO.SUB_OPTION_ID, PSO.VALUE_NAME, PSO.PRICE_DIFF FROM PRODUCT_OPTION_TBL PO LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_SUB_OPTION_TBL PSO ON PO.TOP_OPTION_ID = PSO.TOP_OPTION_ID WHERE PO.PRO_NO = #{proNo} ORDER BY PO.TOP_OPTION_ID, PSO.SUB_OPTION_ID
SELECT TO_CHAR(DISABLED_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') FROM DISABLED_DATE_TBL WHERE PRO_NO = #{proNo} ORDER BY DISABLED_DATE
SELECT STORE_NAME FROM SELLER_INFO_TBL WHERE STORE_ID = #{storeId}
SELECT P.PRO_NO, P.PRO_NAME, P.PRO_TYPE, P.PRICE, P.STATUS, P.CNT AS STOCK_QTY, P.SELL_COUNT, P.CREATED_AT FROM PRODUCT_TBL P WHERE P.STORE_ID = #{storeId} ORDER BY P.CREATED_AT DESC
mapper.update:
UPDATE USER_TBL
USER_PASS = #{USER_PASS},
USER_NAME = #{USER_NAME},
EMAIL = #{EMAIL},
USER_ADDR = #{USER_ADDR},
PHONE = #{PHONE},
USER_STATUS = #{USER_STATUS}, UDATE = SYSDATE, WHERE USER_ID = #{USER_ID}
mapper.select: SELECT PO.TOP_OPTION_ID, PO.PRO_NO, PO.OPTION_NAME, PO.IS_QUANTITY_SELECTABLE, PSO.SUB_OPTION_ID, PSO.VALUE_NAME, PSO.PRICE_DIFF FROM PRODUCT_OPTION_TBL PO LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_SUB_OPTION_TBL PSO ON PO.TOP_OPTION_ID = PSO.TOP_OPTION_ID WHERE PO.PRO_NO = #{proNo} ORDER BY PO.TOP_OPTION_ID, PSO.SUB_OPTION_ID
SELECT TO_CHAR(DISABLED_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') FROM DISABLED_DATE_TBL WHERE PRO_NO = #{proNo} ORDER BY DISABLED_DATE
mapper.update: UPDATE PRODUCT_TBL SET PRO_NAME = #{proName}, PRO_TYPE = #{proType}, PRICE = #{price}, DELIVERY_FEE = #{deliveryFee}, STATUS = #{status}, LETTERING = #{lettering}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE PRO_NO = #{proNo}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_MSG_TBL WHERE CHAT_ID IN ( SELECT CHAT_ID FROM CHAT_TBL WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} /* 내가 구매자인 채팅방 */ OR STORE_ID IN (SELECT STORE_ID FROM SELLER_INFO_TBL WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}) /* 내가 판매자인 채팅방 */ ) AND IS_READ = 'N' /* 읽지 않은 상태 */ AND USER_ID != #{userId} /* 내가 보낸 메시지가 아닌 경우(상대방이 보낸 것) */

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ORDER_ID) FROM ORDER_TBL T1 INNER JOIN ORDER_DETAIL_TBL T2 ON T1.ORDER_ID = T2.ORDER_ID INNER JOIN PRODUCT_TBL T8 ON T2.PRO_NO = T8.PRO_NO INNER JOIN SELLER_INFO_TBL T10 ON T8.STORE_ID = T10.STORE_ID WHERE T10.USER_ID = #{userId} AND T1.STATUS = 'P' AND TO_CHAR(T1.ORDER_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD')
mapper.update: UPDATE DELIVERY_TBL SET DELIVERY_STATUS = #{deliveryStatus}, DELI_UDATETIME = SYSDATE WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId}
UPDATE PICKUP_TBL SET PICKUP_STATUS = #{pickupStatus}, PICKUP_UDATETIME = SYSDATE WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM PRODUCT_IMG_TBL WHERE PRO_NO = #{proNo} ORDER BY CASE WHEN FILEUSE = 'T' THEN 1 -- 썸네일 WHEN FILEUSE = 'D' THEN 2 -- 상세 이미지 WHEN FILEUSE = 'I' THEN 3 -- 기타 이미지 WHEN FILEUSE = 'B' THEN 4 -- 배경 이미지 WHEN FILEUSE = 'M' THEN 5 -- 메인 이미지 ELSE 6 END, PRODUCT_IMG_NUM
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PRODUCT_IMG_TBL ( PRODUCT_IMG_NUM, PRO_NO, FILEPATH, FILENAME, FILEORGNAME, FILEUSE, FILEETC ) VALUES ( PRODUCT_IMG_SEQ.NEXTVAL, -- 시퀀스 확인 필요 #{proNo}, #{filepath}, #{filename}, #{fileorgname}, #{fileuse}, #{fileetc} )
